summary: Make Tüm Özellikleri Kaldır delete illuminated-foam modules from the scene while resetting all remaining modules to their defaults with placement preserved.

impactAnalysis.notes: F-028 is intentionally narrow. During the existing global feature-reset action, illuminated-foam modules are removed instead of recreated; every other module still passes through the canonical createCatalogModuleState path with preservePlacement=true. The image asset itself remains in the project asset library, so only the scene module/reference is removed. Unknown module types still preserve the existing fail-closed reset behavior. No catalog dimensions, placement rules, project schema, archive format or BOM policy changes are intended.

e2e.reason: The fix changes a browser-visible destructive reset action. Chromium verifies that illuminated foam is removed, the confirmation discloses that removal, and all other module type/width/placement values survive the reset and save path.

risk.notes: The action intentionally deletes illuminated-foam scene modules. Risk is limited to deleting the wrong module family or disturbing other module layout; targeted unit and browser regressions lock both boundaries.

migration.notes: No IndexedDB version, project schema, module schema or ZIP archive schema changes are involved.

rollback: Restore the previous reset handler that maps every current module through createCatalogModuleState and remove the F-028 targeted regressions.
